MANDARIN CHINESE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MANDARIN CHINESE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Phonological Awareness.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Phonological Awareness.

----
12. In three clear sentences, explain Grammar 5.4.1 Word Classes ● Adverbs of Time 每 天,明天,昨天 ● Sentence structure 先... and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
